section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1986
title: 8 ## Metropolitan Cities: The incidence of accidental deaths recorded an increase of 5.6% in 1986 over 1985 in the 12 Metropolitan Cities as a whole out of which 9 registered an increase in the total number of accidental deaths during 1986 over 1985. The 3 Cities which registered a decline in the total number of accidental deaths during 1986 over 1985 were Calcutta, Kanpur and Lucknow.
